name: Chiyomi Nishimura
source:
Animal Type: Cat
Breed: Mixed
Hometown: Kariya, Aichi, Japan

"Freshly immigrated from Japan to Canada in search of better opportunities in life. She is a soft-hearted and amiable person, but can be quite stubborn and absentminded at times without guidance from others."
